verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing site mentions earning 'cash back with a Brex business account' (brex-docs-10), so cashback on spend appears to exist. The pack has nothing on how it is earned or redeemed, so the 'automatic, no manual redemption' part of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: documentation that cashback accrues and pays out automatically without redemption steps, details on cashback rates and eligible card spend, independent or hands-on corroboration.
